items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Nick La Roca lived way down La Roca. In the Irish Channel. Them fellas play good jazz, they're what I'm telling you.

ctx.x: There was another piano player, De La Roque. De La Roque or something.

He lived up back there. Well, that's what they would. Nick La Roca lived way down La Roca. In the Irish Channel. Them fellas play good jazz, they're what I'm telling you. Yeah, some beat. They play some good music. I'll try to find some of them down. I had everything. I just gave up and throw them away. I had more books and everything and pieces, you know. I got even the rights going to the clarinet. Yeah, yeah. And I got them there somewhere in there. Drawing there. Yeah.
When you had, when you played with the band with your violin, Mr. Robinson, were you the leader of the band? I was. You were always a leader. I was. You used to do Stump Off? Yeah, yeah. I see.
